verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents that every Model change, including changes made by Ari or agents, is recorded in a changelog under the user's name and can be undone. Agent tool use runs under an allow/ask/deny policy with human approval. Together these give review and rollback of what automated work writes to the Model. The automations themselves (triggers, alerts, syncs) are not shown to be versioned, reviewable as definitions, or revertible to a prior configuration. missing for 10: versioning of automation/trigger definitions, diff/review of automation configs, rollback of automation settings rather than Model writes, independent corroboration.
